vo.en: Press your arms against a doorway now.

visual.description: A man standing inside a wooden doorway frame preparing for the test.

vo.en: Push your hands outward against the frame as hard as you can.

visual.description: Close up of male hands pressing forcefully against solid wooden walls.

vo.en: Hold steady pressure. This overloads your nervous system and locks your brain signals.

visual.description: Abstract animation of digital brain synapses firing glowing blue electrical signals.

vo.en: But here is the creepy part. Keep pushing for ten more seconds without stopping.

visual.description: Sand pouring rapidly through a sleek glass hourglass on a dark desk.

vo.en: Now step forward and completely relax your shoulders.

visual.description: A man's feet taking a bold step forward onto a polished wooden floor.

vo.en: Your arms will involuntarily float upward into the air like invisible strings are pulling them.

visual.description: A man's arms floating upward effortlessly in a bright room as he looks surprised.

vo.en: This reflex is called the Kohnstamm phenomenon. Subscribe for daily mind hacks, comment YES if it worked, and to trigger this glitch...

visual.description: A digital visual representation of a human head glowing with cybernetic brain networks.
